meta.source: CloudRig generated rig UI + custom properties
meta.note: All values are Blender ID custom-properties living on pose bones of RIG-Freja. Set them via  rig.pose.bones['<owner_bone>']['<prop_name>'] = <value>  then rig.data.update_tag() / frame change to fire drivers.

how_to_read.control: toggle=on/off | enum=pick one label by index | float_slider/int_slider=range | color_rgb=linear RGB 0..1 triplet | direction_vec=xyz | string=text
how_to_read.visible_when: list of {prop, equals}. The setting is only meaningful / shown in the UI when ALL listed sibling props on the same bone hold the given value. equals may be 'True'/'False' or an index string like '1,2' meaning value in {1,2}.
how_to_read.drives: what changes in the 3D scene when the value changes: object_visibility (mesh shown/hidden), modifier_toggle, shape_key (morph), material_value (shader input), shader_nodegroup, geonodes_mask (body part masked away under clothing).

shared_meshes: Freja_Nude_Body (83 shape keys - the base body all masks/morphs act on)

settings.label: Quality
settings.description: Switch the quality here to adjust the modifiers on the character: Use Performance if you wish to disable heavier modifiers (WARNING: This will cause the RENDER and VIEWPORT to look different! Use Performance when you work, then disable it by switching back to Default, or use Render or other settings to preview much heavier modifiers! (Might lead to huge performance loss in viewport!)

settings.label: Physics Jacket
settings.description: Enable physics on the jacket straps

settings.label: Physics Thighs
settings.description: Recommended to use against other objects, not self intersection

settings.label: Skin
settings.description: When more added later, will be included here.

settings.label: Tattoo
settings.description: By default this skin disables the tattoos on Freja in the game. But you can still enable it back here.
